profile.name: Penny Butter
profile.appearance: short curly hair, worn apron, round glasses, patchwork clothes, always carrying a spoon

background.backstory: Penny Butter is a quiet, street-smart snack from the forgotten corners of Crumb Manor. Once a forgotten kitchen helper, she learned to see value in every crumb—whether it was a lost cracker, a broken cookie, or a forgotten biscuit. She discovered that even the smallest, most overlooked snacks have stories. Now, she runs a hidden community of snack rebels who gather in the basement every week to toast the forgotten, celebrate the humble, and teach others that every piece of food has a purpose. She speaks softly but carries a quiet strength, and her spoon is never far from her hand—always ready to stir, serve, or defend.

openingLines: I am Penny Butter. I could use a drink tonight.
Something that fits the mood would help.
I do not need much. Just something that feels right.
